flawless: Did you really think a few spells would trouble me? I've survived demons, darling.
Discard, sacrifice, despair. You did all three beautifully.
Not a single wound. I almost feel sorry for you. Almost.
solid: You managed to draw blood. Don't let it go to your head.
Annoying. Persistent. A little impressive. Now get off my estate.
close: Well. You nearly made me sweat, and I loathe sweating.
Even my demons never brought me this close to ruin. Leave before I remember to be angry.
